Done. The plan at `out/T3/plan.yaml` succeeded on its first execution and wrote the sharded checkpoint to `out/T3/`.

What the plan does:
- Asserts the input has 160 tensors, 48 projection matrices, and 12 mask buffers.
- Deletes the 12 causal-mask buffers named `h.<i>.attn.bias` with an anchored regex.
- Casts only the four projection matrices per layer to bfloat16 with cast_ in place.
- Runs the required checks as one `all` assertion: the 48 projections are bfloat16, every other tensor (negative-lookahead pattern) is float32, `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight` is bfloat16, `wte.weight` is float32, no buffers remain, and the total is 148.
- Writes safetensors with a 64MB shard budget.

Output layout:

| File | Bytes |
|---|---|
| model-00001-of-00004.safetensors | 66,264,976 |
| model-00002-of-00004.safetensors | 66,261,800 |
| model-00003-of-00004.safetensors | 40,986,064 |
| model-00004-of-00004.safetensors (wte.weight alone) | 154,389,592 |

A separate read-only verification plan confirmed the float32 complement pattern matches exactly 100 tensors, so the "exactly 48 bfloat16" check is genuine. The self-report is in `out/T3/REPORT.md`. One doc nit noted there: the help text lists only `target` under allowed keys for cast_, though `to` is required.
